code: ellmer_judge <- function(chat, type = grade_type, max_active = 4) {   function(data) {     if (length(chat$get_turns()) > 0) {       stop("Use a chat with no conversation history as a judge.")     }     prompts <- interpolate(       "{{input}}\n\nCriterion: {{target}}",       input = data$input,       target = data$target     )     graded <- parallel_chat_structured(       chat,       prompts,       type = type,       max_active = max_active,       on_error = "continue"     )     if (".error" %in% names(graded)) {       failed <- sum(!vapply(graded$.error, is.null, logical(1)))       warning(failed, " of ", nrow(data), " requests failed; their labels are NA.")       graded$.error <- NULL     }     graded$label <- as.character(graded$label)     tibble::tibble(.item_id = data$.item_id, graded)   } }

code: keyword_judge <- function(data) {   hedged <- grepl("probably|somewhere|should be|I think|I believe|might|sometimes|could", data$input)   concrete <- grepl("Answer: (Open|Use|Yes)|click", data$input)   label <- ifelse(hedged, "P", ifelse(concrete, "C", "I"))   # The flaw under audit: a long input reads as one level more complete.   long <- nchar(data$input) > 240   label[long & label == "P"] <- "C"   label[long & label == "I"] <- "P"   # A little run-to-run error, so repeated runs are not identical.   noise <- runif(nrow(data)) < 0.05   label[noise] <- sample(c("I", "P", "C"), sum(noise), replace = TRUE)   tibble::tibble(.item_id = data$.item_id, label = label) }  cal <- calibrate_judge(   synthetic_gold,   judge = keyword_judge,   human_cols = c("rater_1", "rater_2", "rater_3"),   input_cols = c("input", "target"),   id_col = "id",   label_levels = c("I", "P", "C"),   scale = "ordinal",   n_boot = 500,   seed = 1,   provenance = list(model = "synthetic keyword judge", prompt_version = "v1"),   audit_id = "synthetic-judge-v1" ) bias <- probe_bias(   synthetic_gold,   keyword_judge,   input_cols = c("input", "target"),   probes = c("verbosity", "self_preference", "bandwagon"),   seed = 1,   audit_id = "synthetic-judge-v1" ) stability <- test_retest(   synthetic_gold,   keyword_judge,   input_cols = c("input", "target"),   n_runs = 5,   label_levels = c("I", "P", "C"),   weights = "ordinal",   n_boot = 500,   seed = 1,   audit_id = "synthetic-judge-v1" )
